name: Superconduction / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A thin high cold metallic singing whistle sweeps downward, fractures into tiny crystalline ticks, and leaves a fine needle-like electrical fizz. Icy electrical conduction, no bass explosion.
